items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Retain both control-plane opportunities as deferred backlog; do not queue, requeue, deploy, add telemetry or dependencies, spend, expand monetization, or claim financial impact this cycle. Continue existing repair-or-close, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, measurement reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Reconsider only after ownership, root cause, isolation, validation, rollback, and measurement readiness are documented.

Maintain financial containment. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed and keep ROI, margin, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift unknown. Use existing recorded telemetry only; do not create duplicate measurement requests or infer returns from traffic, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance, ordered items, shipped items, or AI usage.

Keep private launch gates and parked-site dispositions unchanged. Continue only the existing consolidated legal, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work. Keep external outreach unsent and authorize no public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, credential or configuration changes, dependency additions, or deployment.
